speaker: elkanah
text: Hannah, why are you crying?
name: Elkanah

speaker: elkanah
text: Why won’t you eat? Why is your heart so grieved? Am I not better to you than ten sons?
name: Elkanah

speaker: hannah
text: O LORD of Hosts, if only You will look upon the affliction of Your maidservant and remember me, not forgetting Your maidservant but giving her a son, then I will dedicate him to the LORD all the days of his life, and no razor shall ever come over his head.
name: Hannah

speaker: eli
text: How long will you be drunk? Put away your wine!
name: Eli

speaker: hannah
text: No, my lord,
name: Hannah

speaker: hannah
text: I am a woman oppressed in spirit. I have not had any wine or strong drink, but I have poured out my soul before the LORD.
name: Hannah

speaker: hannah
text: Do not take your servant for a wicked woman; for all this time I have been praying out of the depth of my anguish and grief.
name: Hannah

speaker: eli
text: Go in peace,
name: Eli

speaker: eli
text: and may the God of Israel grant the petition you have asked of Him.
name: Eli

speaker: hannah
text: May your maidservant find favor with you,
name: Hannah

speaker: hannah
text: Because I have asked for him from the LORD.
name: Hannah

speaker: hannah
text: After the boy is weaned,
name: Hannah

speaker: hannah
text: I will take him to appear before the LORD and to stay there permanently.
name: Hannah

speaker: elkanah
text: Do what you think is best,
name: Elkanah

speaker: elkanah
text: and stay here until you have weaned him. Only may the LORD confirm His word.
name: Elkanah

speaker: hannah
text: Please, my lord,
name: Hannah

speaker: hannah
text: as surely as you live, my lord, I am the woman who stood here beside you praying to the LORD.
name: Hannah

speaker: hannah
text: I prayed for this boy, and since the LORD has granted me what I asked of Him,
name: Hannah

speaker: hannah
text: I now dedicate the boy to the LORD. For as long as he lives, he is dedicated to the LORD.
name: Hannah

speaker: hannah
text: My heart rejoices in the LORD in whom my horn is exalted. My mouth speaks boldly against my enemies, for I rejoice in Your salvation.
name: Hannah

speaker: hannah
text: There is no one holy like the LORD. Indeed, there is no one besides You! And there is no Rock like our God.
name: Hannah

speaker: hannah
text: Do not boast so proudly, or let arrogance come from your mouth, for the LORD is a God who knows, and by Him actions are weighed.
name: Hannah

speaker: hannah
text: The bows of the mighty are broken, but the feeble are equipped with strength.
name: Hannah

speaker: hannah
text: The well-fed hire themselves out for food, but the starving hunger no more. The barren woman gives birth to seven, but she who has many sons pines away.
name: Hannah

speaker: hannah
text: The LORD brings death and gives life; He brings down to Sheol and raises up.
name: Hannah

speaker: hannah
text: The LORD sends poverty and wealth; He humbles and He exalts.
name: Hannah

speaker: hannah
text: He raises the poor from the dust and lifts the needy from the ash heap. He seats them among princes and bestows on them a throne of honor. For the foundations of the earth are the LORD’s, and upon them He has set the world.
name: Hannah

speaker: hannah
text: He guards the steps of His faithful ones, but the wicked perish in darkness; for by his own strength shall no man prevail.
name: Hannah

speaker: hannah
text: Those who oppose the LORD will be shattered. He will thunder from heaven against them. The LORD will judge the ends of the earth and will give power to His king. He will exalt the horn of His anointed.
name: Hannah

speaker: servant-of-the-priest
text: Give the priest some meat to roast, because he will not accept boiled meat from you, but only raw.
name: The priest's servant

speaker: unnamed-worshiper
text: The fat must be burned first; then you may take whatever you want,
name: A worshiper

speaker: servant-of-the-priest
text: No, you must give it to me right now. If you refuse, I will take it by force!
name: The priest's servant

speaker: eli
text: May the LORD give you children by this woman in place of the one she dedicated to the LORD.
name: Eli

speaker: eli
text: Why are you doing these things?
name: Eli

speaker: eli
text: I hear about your wicked deeds from all these people.
name: Eli

speaker: eli
text: No, my sons; it is not a good report I hear circulating among the LORD’s people.
name: Eli

speaker: eli
text: If a man sins against another man, God can intercede for him; but if a man sins against the LORD, who can intercede for him?
name: Eli

speaker: man-of-god
text: This is what the LORD says: ‘Did I not clearly reveal Myself to your father’s house when they were in Egypt under Pharaoh’s house?
name: A man of God

speaker: man-of-god
text: And out of all the tribes of Israel I selected your father to be My priest, to offer sacrifices on My altar, to burn incense, and to wear an ephod in My presence. I also gave to the house of your father all the offerings of the Israelites made by fire.
name: A man of God

speaker: man-of-god
text: Why then do you kick at My sacrifice and offering that I have prescribed for My dwelling place? You have honored your sons more than Me by fattening yourselves with the best of all the offerings of My people Israel.’
name: A man of God

speaker: man-of-god
text: Therefore, the LORD, the God of Israel, declares: ‘I did indeed say that your house and the house of your father would walk before Me forever. But now the LORD declares: Far be it from Me! For I will honor those who honor Me, but those who despise Me will be disdained.
name: A man of God

speaker: man-of-god
text: Behold, the days are coming when I will cut off your strength and the strength of your father’s house, so that no older man will be left in your house.
name: A man of God

speaker: man-of-god
text: You will see distress in My dwelling place. Despite all that is good in Israel, no one in your house will ever again reach old age.
name: A man of God

speaker: man-of-god
text: And every one of you that I do not cut off from My altar, your eyes will fail and your heart will grieve. All your descendants will die by the sword of men.
name: A man of God

speaker: man-of-god
text: And this sign shall come to you concerning your two sons Hophni and Phinehas: They will both die on the same day.
name: A man of God

speaker: man-of-god
text: Then I will raise up for Myself a faithful priest. He will do whatever is in My heart and mind. And I will build for him an enduring house, and he will walk before My anointed one for all time.
name: A man of God

speaker: man-of-god
text: And everyone left in your house will come and bow down to him for a piece of silver or a morsel of bread, pleading, “Please appoint me to some priestly office so that I can eat a piece of bread.”’
name: A man of God

speaker: samuel
text: Here I am.
name: Samuel

speaker: samuel
text: Here I am, for you have called me.
name: Samuel

speaker: eli
text: I did not call,
name: Eli

speaker: eli
text: Go back and lie down.
name: Eli

speaker: god
text: Samuel!
name: The LORD

speaker: samuel
text: Here I am, for you have called me.
name: Samuel

speaker: eli
text: My son, I did not call,
name: Eli

speaker: eli
text: Go back and lie down.
name: Eli

speaker: samuel
text: Here I am, for you have called me.
name: Samuel

speaker: eli
text: Go and lie down,
name: Eli

speaker: eli
text: and if He calls you, say, ‘Speak, LORD, for Your servant is listening.’
name: Eli

speaker: god
text: Samuel! Samuel!
name: The LORD

speaker: samuel
text: Speak, for Your servant is listening.
name: Samuel

speaker: god
text: I am about to do something in Israel at which the ears of all who hear it will tingle.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: On that day I will carry out against Eli everything I have spoken about his family, from beginning to end.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: I told him that I would judge his house forever for the iniquity of which he knows, because his sons blasphemed God and he did not restrain them.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Therefore I have sworn to the house of Eli, ‘The iniquity of Eli’s house shall never be atoned for by sacrifice or offering.’
name: The LORD

speaker: eli
text: Samuel, my son.
name: Eli

speaker: samuel
text: Here I am,
name: Samuel

speaker: eli
text: What was the message He gave you?
name: Eli

speaker: eli
text: Do not hide it from me. May God punish you, and ever so severely, if you hide from me anything He said to you.
name: Eli

speaker: eli
text: He is the LORD,
name: Eli

speaker: eli
text: Let Him do what is good in His eyes.
name: Eli

speaker: elders-of-israel
text: Why has the LORD brought defeat on us before the Philistines today? Let us bring the ark of the covenant of the LORD from Shiloh, so that it may go with us to save us from the hand of our enemies.
name: The elders of Israel

speaker: philistines
text: What is this loud shouting in the camp of the Hebrews?
name: The Philistines

speaker: philistines
text: The gods have entered their camp!
name: The Philistines

speaker: philistines
text: Woe to us, for nothing like this has happened before.
name: The Philistines

speaker: philistines
text: Woe to us! Who will deliver us from the hand of these mighty gods? These are the gods who struck the Egyptians with all kinds of plagues in the wilderness.
name: The Philistines

speaker: philistines
text: Take courage and be men, O Philistines! Otherwise, you will serve the Hebrews just as they served you. Now be men and fight!
name: The Philistines

speaker: eli
text: Why this commotion?
name: Eli

speaker: benjamite-messenger
text: I have just come from the battle,
name: The Benjamite messenger

speaker: benjamite-messenger
text: I fled from there today.
name: The Benjamite messenger

speaker: eli
text: What happened, my son?
name: Eli

speaker: benjamite-messenger
text: Israel has fled before the Philistines, and there has been a great slaughter among the people. Your two sons, Hophni and Phinehas, are both dead, and the ark of God has been captured.
name: The Benjamite messenger

speaker: attending-women
text: Do not be afraid, for you have given birth to a son!
name: The attending women

speaker: wife-of-phinehas
text: The glory has departed from Israel,
name: Phinehas's wife

speaker: wife-of-phinehas
text: The glory has departed from Israel,
name: Phinehas's wife

speaker: wife-of-phinehas
text: for the ark of God has been captured.
name: Phinehas's wife

speaker: men-of-ashdod
text: The ark of the God of Israel must not stay here with us, because His hand is heavy upon us and upon our god Dagon.
name: The men of Ashdod

speaker: men-of-ashdod
text: What shall we do with the ark of the God of Israel?
name: The men of Ashdod

speaker: philistine-rulers
text: It must be moved to Gath,
name: The Philistine rulers

speaker: ekronites
text: They have brought us the ark of the God of Israel in order to kill us and our people!
name: The Ekronites

speaker: ekronites
text: Send away the ark of the God of Israel. It must return to its place, so that it will not kill us and our people!
name: The Ekronites

speaker: philistines
text: What shall we do with the ark of the LORD? Tell us how to send it back to its place.
name: The Philistines

speaker: philistine-priests
text: If you return the ark of the God of Israel, do not send it away empty, but by all means return it to Him with a guilt offering. Then you will be healed, and you will understand why His hand has not been lifted from you.
name: The Philistine priests and diviners

speaker: philistines
text: What guilt offering should we send back to Him?
name: The Philistines

speaker: philistine-priests
text: Five gold tumors and five gold rats,
name: The Philistine priests and diviners

speaker: philistine-priests
text: according to the number of rulers of the Philistines, since the same plague has struck both you and your rulers.
name: The Philistine priests and diviners

speaker: philistine-priests
text: Make images of your tumors and of the rats that are ravaging the land. Give glory to the God of Israel, and perhaps He will lift His hand from you and your gods and your land.
name: The Philistine priests and diviners

speaker: philistine-priests
text: Why harden your hearts as the Egyptians and Pharaoh hardened theirs? When He afflicted them, did they not send the people on their way as they departed?
name: The Philistine priests and diviners

speaker: philistine-priests
text: Now, therefore, prepare one new cart with two milk cows that have never been yoked. Hitch the cows to the cart, but take their calves away and pen them up.
name: The Philistine priests and diviners

speaker: philistine-priests
text: Take the ark of the LORD, set it on the cart, and in a chest beside it put the gold objects you are sending Him as a guilt offering. Then send the ark on its way,
name: The Philistine priests and diviners

speaker: philistine-priests
text: but keep watching it. If it goes up the road to its homeland, toward Beth-shemesh, it is the LORD who has brought on us this great disaster. But if it does not, then we will know that it was not His hand that punished us and that it happened by chance.
name: The Philistine priests and diviners

speaker: men-of-beth-shemesh
text: Who can stand in the presence of the LORD, this holy God? To whom should the ark go up from here?
name: The men of Beth-shemesh

speaker: men-of-beth-shemesh
text: The Philistines have returned the ark of the LORD. Come down and take it up with you.
name: The men of Beth-shemesh

speaker: samuel
text: If you are returning to the LORD with all your hearts, then rid yourselves of the foreign gods and Ashtoreths among you, prepare your hearts for the LORD, and serve Him only. And He will deliver you from the hand of the Philistines.
name: Samuel

speaker: samuel
text: Gather all Israel to Mizpah, and I will pray to the LORD on your behalf.
name: Samuel

speaker: israelites
text: We have sinned against the LORD.
name: The Israelites

speaker: israelites
text: Do not stop crying out to the LORD our God for us, that He may save us from the hand of the Philistines.
name: The Israelites

speaker: samuel
text: Thus far the LORD has helped us.
name: Samuel

speaker: elders-of-israel
text: Look,
name: The elders of Israel

speaker: elders-of-israel
text: you are old, and your sons do not walk in your ways. Now appoint a king to judge us like all the other nations.
name: The elders of Israel

speaker: elders-of-israel
text: Give us a king to judge us,
name: The elders of Israel

speaker: god
text: Listen to the voice of the people in all that they say to you. For it is not you they have rejected, but they have rejected Me as their king.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Just as they have done from the day I brought them up out of Egypt until this day, forsaking Me and serving other gods, so they are doing to you.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Now listen to them, but you must solemnly warn them and show them the manner of the king who will reign over them.
name: The LORD

speaker: samuel
text: This will be the manner of the king who will reign over you: He will take your sons and appoint them to his own chariots and horses, to run in front of his chariots.
name: Samuel

speaker: samuel
text: He will appoint some for himself as commanders of thousands and of fifties, and others to plow his ground, to reap his harvest, to make his weapons of war, and to equip his chariots.
name: Samuel

speaker: samuel
text: And he will take your daughters to be perfumers, cooks, and bakers.
name: Samuel

speaker: samuel
text: He will take the best of your fields and vineyards and olive groves and give them to his servants.
name: Samuel

speaker: samuel
text: He will take a tenth of your grain and grape harvest and give it to his officials and servants.
name: Samuel

speaker: samuel
text: And he will take your menservants and maidservants and your best cattle and donkeys and put them to his own use.
name: Samuel

speaker: samuel
text: He will take a tenth of your flocks, and you yourselves will become his slaves.
name: Samuel

speaker: samuel
text: When that day comes, you will beg for relief from the king you have chosen, but the LORD will not answer you on that day.
name: Samuel

speaker: israelites
text: No!
name: The Israelites

speaker: israelites
text: We must have a king over us.
name: The Israelites

speaker: israelites
text: Then we will be like all the other nations, with a king to judge us, to go out before us, and to fight our battles.
name: The Israelites

speaker: god
text: Listen to their voice,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Appoint a king for them.
name: The LORD

speaker: samuel
text: Everyone must go back to his city.
name: Samuel

speaker: kish
text: Take one of the servants and go look for the donkeys.
name: Kish

speaker: saul
text: Come, let us go back, or my father will stop worrying about the donkeys and start worrying about us.
name: Saul

speaker: saul-servant
text: Look,
name: Saul's servant

speaker: saul-servant
text: in this city there is a man of God who is highly respected; everything he says surely comes to pass. Let us go there now. Perhaps he will tell us which way to go.
name: Saul's servant

speaker: saul
text: If we do go,
name: Saul

speaker: saul
text: what can we give the man? For the bread in our packs is gone, and there is no gift to take to the man of God. What do we have?
name: Saul

speaker: saul-servant
text: Look,
name: Saul's servant

speaker: saul-servant
text: I have here in my hand a quarter shekel of silver. I will give it to the man of God, and he will tell us our way.
name: Saul's servant

speaker: saul
text: Good,
name: Saul

speaker: saul
text: Come, let us go.
name: Saul

speaker: saul
text: Is the seer here?
name: Saul

speaker: young-women
text: Yes, he is ahead of you,
name: The young women

speaker: young-women
text: Hurry now, for today he has come to the city because the people have a sacrifice on the high place.
name: The young women

speaker: young-women
text: As soon as you enter the city, you will find him before he goes up to the high place to eat. The people will not eat until he comes, because he must bless the sacrifice; after that, the guests will eat. Go up at once; you will find him.
name: The young women

speaker: god
text: At this time tomorrow I will send you a man from the land of Benjamin, and you are to anoint him leader over My people Israel; he will save them from the hand of the Philistines. For I have looked upon My people, because their cry has come to Me.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Here is the man of whom I spoke; he shall rule over My people.
name: The LORD

speaker: saul
text: Would you please tell me where the seer’s house is?
name: Saul

speaker: samuel
text: I am the seer,
name: Samuel

speaker: samuel
text: Go up before me to the high place, for you shall eat with me today. And when I send you off in the morning, I will tell you all that is in your heart.
name: Samuel

speaker: samuel
text: As for the donkeys you lost three days ago, do not worry about them, for they have been found. And upon whom is all the desire of Israel, if not upon you and all your father’s house?
name: Samuel

speaker: saul
text: Am I not a Benjamite from the smallest tribe of Israel, and is not my clan the least of all the clans of Benjamin? So why would you say such a thing to me?
name: Saul

speaker: samuel
text: Bring the portion I gave you and told you to set aside.
name: Samuel

speaker: samuel
text: Here is what was kept back. It was set apart for you. Eat, for it has been kept for you for this occasion, from the time I said, ‘I have invited the people.’
name: Samuel

speaker: samuel
text: Get ready, and I will send you on your way!
name: Samuel

speaker: samuel
text: Tell the servant to go on ahead of us, but you stay for a while, and I will reveal to you the word of God.
name: Samuel

speaker: samuel
text: Has not the LORD anointed you ruler over His inheritance?
name: Samuel

speaker: samuel
text: When you leave me today, you will find two men at Rachel’s tomb in Zelzah on the border of Benjamin. They will say to you, ‘The donkeys you seek have been found, and now your father has stopped worrying about the donkeys and started worrying about you, asking, “What should I do about my son?”’
name: Samuel

speaker: samuel
text: Then you will go on from there until you come to the Oak of Tabor. Three men going up to God at Bethel will meet you there, one carrying three young goats, another carrying three loaves of bread, and another carrying a skin of wine.
name: Samuel

speaker: samuel
text: They will greet you and give you two loaves of bread, which you will accept from their hands.
name: Samuel

speaker: samuel
text: After that you will come to Gibeah of God, where the Philistines have an outpost. As you approach the city, you will meet a group of prophets coming down from the high place, preceded by harps, tambourines, flutes, and lyres, and they will be prophesying.
name: Samuel

speaker: samuel
text: Then the Spirit of the LORD will rush upon you, and you will prophesy with them; and you will be transformed into a different person.
name: Samuel

speaker: samuel
text: When these signs have come, do as the occasion demands, for God is with you.
name: Samuel

speaker: samuel
text: And you shall go before me to Gilgal, and surely I will come to you to offer burnt offerings and to sacrifice peace offerings. Wait seven days until I come to you and show you what you are to do.
name: Samuel

speaker: saul-acquaintances
text: What has happened to the son of Kish? Is Saul also among the prophets?
name: People who knew Saul

speaker: man-of-gibeah
text: And who is their father?
name: A man who lived there

speaker: saul-uncle
text: Where did you go?
name: Saul's uncle

speaker: saul
text: To look for the donkeys,
name: Saul

speaker: saul
text: When we saw they were not to be found, we went to Samuel.
name: Saul

speaker: saul-uncle
text: Tell me,
name: Saul's uncle

speaker: saul-uncle
text: what did Samuel say to you?
name: Saul's uncle

speaker: saul
text: He assured us that the donkeys had been found.
name: Saul

speaker: samuel
text: This is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says: ‘I brought Israel up out of Egypt, and I rescued you from the hands of the Egyptians and of all the kingdoms that oppressed you.’
name: Samuel

speaker: samuel
text: But today you have rejected your God, who saves you from all your troubles and afflictions, and you have said to Him, ‘No, set a king over us.’ Now therefore present yourselves before the LORD by your tribes and clans.
name: Samuel

speaker: israelites
text: Has the man come here yet?
name: The Israelites

speaker: god
text: Behold, he has hidden himself among the baggage.
name: The LORD

speaker: samuel
text: Do you see the one the LORD has chosen? There is no one like him among all the people.
name: Samuel

speaker: israelites
text: Long live the king!
name: The Israelites

speaker: worthless-men
text: How can this man save us?
name: Worthless men

speaker: men-of-jabesh
text: Make a treaty with us, and we will serve you.
name: The men of Jabesh

speaker: nahash
text: I will make a treaty with you on one condition, that I may put out everyone’s right eye and bring reproach upon all Israel.
name: Nahash the Ammonite

speaker: elders-of-jabesh
text: Hold off for seven days,
name: The elders of Jabesh

speaker: elders-of-jabesh
text: and let us send messengers throughout Israel. If there is no one to save us, we will surrender to you.
name: The elders of Jabesh

speaker: saul
text: What troubles the people?
name: Saul

speaker: saul
text: Why are they weeping?
name: Saul

speaker: saul
text: This is what will be done to the oxen of anyone who does not march behind Saul and Samuel.
name: Saul

speaker: israelites
text: Tell the men of Jabesh-gilead: ‘Deliverance will be yours tomorrow by the time the sun is hot.’
name: The Israelites

speaker: men-of-jabesh
text: Tomorrow we will come out, and you can do with us whatever seems good to you.
name: The men of Jabesh

speaker: israelites
text: Who said that Saul should not reign over us? Bring those men here so we can kill them!
name: The Israelites

speaker: saul
text: No one shall be put to death this day, for today the LORD has worked salvation in Israel.
name: Saul

speaker: samuel
text: Come, let us go to Gilgal and renew the kingship there.
name: Samuel

speaker: samuel
text: I have listened to your voice in all that you have said to me, and I have set over you a king.
name: Samuel

speaker: samuel
text: Now here is the king walking before you, and I am old and gray, and my sons are here with you. I have walked before you from my youth until this day.
name: Samuel

speaker: samuel
text: Here I am. Bear witness against me before the LORD and before His anointed: Whose ox or donkey have I taken? Whom have I cheated or oppressed? From whose hand have I accepted a bribe and closed my eyes? Tell me, and I will restore it to you.
name: Samuel

speaker: israelites
text: You have not wronged us or oppressed us,
name: The Israelites

speaker: israelites
text: nor have you taken anything from the hand of man.
name: The Israelites

speaker: samuel
text: The LORD is a witness against you, and His anointed is a witness today, that you have not found anything in my hand.
name: Samuel

speaker: israelites
text: He is a witness,
name: The Israelites

speaker: samuel
text: The LORD is the One who appointed Moses and Aaron, and who brought your fathers up out of the land of Egypt.
name: Samuel

speaker: samuel
text: Now present yourselves, so that I may confront you before the LORD with all the righteous acts He has done for you and your fathers.
name: Samuel

speaker: samuel
text: When Jacob went to Egypt, your fathers cried out to the LORD, and He sent them Moses and Aaron, who brought your fathers out of Egypt and settled them in this place.
name: Samuel

speaker: samuel
text: But they forgot the LORD their God, and He sold them into the hand of Sisera the commander of the army of Hazor, and into the hands of the Philistines and the king of Moab, who fought against them.
name: Samuel

speaker: samuel
text: Then they cried out to the LORD and said, ‘We have sinned, for we have forsaken the LORD and served the Baals and Ashtoreths. Now deliver us from the hands of our enemies, that we may serve You.’
name: Samuel

speaker: samuel
text: So the LORD sent Jerubbaal, Barak, Jephthah, and Samuel, and He delivered you from the hands of your enemies on every side, and you dwelt securely.
name: Samuel

speaker: samuel
text: But when you saw that Nahash king of the Ammonites was moving against you, you said to me, ‘No, we must have a king to rule over us’—even though the LORD your God was your king.
name: Samuel

speaker: samuel
text: Now here is the king you have chosen, the one you requested. Behold, the LORD has placed a king over you.
name: Samuel

speaker: samuel
text: If you fear the LORD and serve Him and obey His voice, and if you do not rebel against the command of the LORD, and if both you and the king who reigns over you follow the LORD your God, then all will be well.
name: Samuel

speaker: samuel
text: But if you disobey the LORD and rebel against His command, then the hand of the LORD will be against you as it was against your fathers.
name: Samuel

speaker: samuel
text: Now, therefore, stand and see this great thing that the LORD will do before your eyes.
name: Samuel

speaker: samuel
text: Is it not the wheat harvest today? I will call on the LORD to send thunder and rain, so that you will know and see what a great evil you have committed in the sight of the LORD by asking for a king.
name: Samuel

speaker: israelites
text: Pray to the LORD your God for your servants so that we will not die! For we have added to all our sins the evil of asking for a king.
name: The Israelites

speaker: samuel
text: Do not be afraid,
name: Samuel

speaker: samuel
text: Even though you have committed all this evil, do not turn aside from following the LORD, but serve the LORD with all your heart.
name: Samuel

speaker: samuel
text: Do not turn aside after worthless things that cannot profit you or deliver you, for they are empty.
name: Samuel

speaker: samuel
text: Indeed, for the sake of His great name, the LORD will not abandon His people, because He was pleased to make you His own.
name: Samuel

speaker: samuel
text: As for me, far be it from me that I should sin against the LORD by ceasing to pray for you. And I will continue to teach you the good and right way.
name: Samuel

speaker: samuel
text: Above all, fear the LORD and serve Him faithfully with all your heart; consider what great things He has done for you.
name: Samuel

speaker: samuel
text: But if you persist in doing evil, both you and your king will be swept away.
name: Samuel

speaker: saul
text: Let the Hebrews hear!
name: Saul

speaker: saul
text: Bring me the burnt offering and the peace offerings.
name: Saul

speaker: samuel
text: What have you done?
name: Samuel

speaker: saul
text: When I saw that the troops were deserting me, and that you did not come at the appointed time and the Philistines were gathering at Michmash,
name: Saul

speaker: saul
text: I thought, ‘Now the Philistines will descend upon me at Gilgal, and I have not sought the favor of the LORD.’ So I felt compelled to offer the burnt offering.
name: Saul

speaker: samuel
text: You have acted foolishly,
name: Samuel

speaker: samuel
text: You have not kept the command that the LORD your God gave you; if you had, the LORD would have established your kingdom over Israel for all time.
name: Samuel

speaker: samuel
text: But now your kingdom will not endure; the LORD has sought a man after His own heart and appointed him ruler over His people, because you have not kept the command of the LORD.
name: Samuel

speaker: philistines
text: The Hebrews must not be allowed to make swords or spears.
name: The Philistines

speaker: jonathan
text: Come, let us cross over to the Philistine outpost on the other side.
name: Jonathan

speaker: jonathan
text: Come, let us cross over to the outpost of these uncircumcised men. Perhaps the LORD will work on our behalf. Nothing can hinder the LORD from saving, whether by many or by few.
name: Jonathan

speaker: armor-bearer
text: Do all that is in your heart. Go ahead; I am with you heart and soul.
name: Jonathan's armor-bearer

speaker: jonathan
text: Very well,
name: Jonathan

speaker: jonathan
text: we will cross over toward these men and show ourselves to them.
name: Jonathan

speaker: jonathan
text: If they say, ‘Wait until we come to you,’ then we will stay where we are and will not go up to them.
name: Jonathan

speaker: jonathan
text: But if they say, ‘Come on up,’ then we will go up, because this will be our sign that the LORD has delivered them into our hands.
name: Jonathan

speaker: philistine-outpost
text: Look, the Hebrews are coming out of the holes in which they were hiding!
name: The Philistine outpost

speaker: philistine-outpost
text: Come on up, and we will teach you a lesson!
name: The Philistine outpost

speaker: jonathan
text: Follow me,
name: Jonathan

speaker: jonathan
text: for the LORD has delivered them into the hand of Israel.
name: Jonathan

speaker: saul
text: Call the roll and see who has left us.
name: Saul

speaker: saul
text: Bring the ark of God.
name: Saul

speaker: saul
text: Withdraw your hand.
name: Saul

speaker: saul
text: Cursed is the man who eats any food before evening, before I have taken vengeance on my enemies.
name: Saul

speaker: israelite-soldier
text: Your father bound the troops with a solemn oath, saying, ‘Cursed is the man who eats food today.’ That is why the people are faint.
name: A soldier

speaker: jonathan
text: My father has brought trouble to the land,
name: Jonathan

speaker: jonathan
text: Just look at how my eyes have brightened because I tasted a little of this honey.
name: Jonathan

speaker: jonathan
text: How much better it would have been if the troops had eaten freely today from the plunder they took from their enemies! Would not the slaughter of the Philistines have been much greater?
name: Jonathan

speaker: unnamed-informant
text: Look, the troops are sinning against the LORD by eating meat with the blood still in it.
name: An informant

speaker: saul
text: You have broken faith,
name: Saul

speaker: saul
text: Roll a large stone over here at once.
name: Saul

speaker: saul
text: Go among the troops and tell them, ‘Each man must bring me his ox or his sheep, slaughter them in this place, and then eat. Do not sin against the LORD by eating meat with the blood still in it.’
name: Saul

speaker: saul
text: Let us go down after the Philistines by night and plunder them until dawn, leaving no man alive!
name: Saul

speaker: israelites
text: Do what seems good to you,
name: The Israelites

speaker: ahijah
text: We must consult God here.
name: Ahijah the priest

speaker: saul
text: Shall I go down after the Philistines? Will You give them into the hand of Israel?
name: Saul

speaker: saul
text: Come here, all you leaders of the troops, and let us investigate how this sin has occurred today.
name: Saul

speaker: saul
text: As surely as the LORD who saves Israel lives, even if it is my son Jonathan, he must die!
name: Saul

speaker: saul
text: You stand on one side, and I and my son Jonathan will stand on the other side.
name: Saul

speaker: israelites
text: Do what seems good to you,
name: The Israelites

speaker: saul
text: Why have You not answered Your servant this day? If the fault is with me or my son Jonathan, respond with Urim; but if the fault is with the men of Israel, respond with Thummim.
name: Saul

speaker: saul
text: Cast the lot between me and my son Jonathan.
name: Saul

speaker: saul
text: Tell me what you have done,
name: Saul

speaker: jonathan
text: I only tasted a little honey with the end of the staff that was in my hand. And now I must die?
name: Jonathan

speaker: saul
text: May God punish me, and ever so severely, if you, Jonathan, do not surely die!
name: Saul

speaker: israelites
text: Must Jonathan die—he who accomplished such a great deliverance for Israel? Never! As surely as the LORD lives, not a hair of his head will fall to the ground, for with God’s help he has accomplished this today.
name: The Israelites

speaker: samuel
text: The LORD sent me to anoint you king over His people Israel. Now therefore, listen to the words of the LORD.
name: Samuel

speaker: samuel
text: This is what the LORD of Hosts says: ‘I witnessed what the Amalekites did to the Israelites when they ambushed them on their way up from Egypt.
name: Samuel

speaker: samuel
text: Now go and attack the Amalekites and devote to destruction all that belongs to them. Do not spare them, but put to death men and women, children and infants, oxen and sheep, camels and donkeys.’
name: Samuel

speaker: saul
text: Since you showed kindness to all the Israelites when they came up out of Egypt, go on and get away from the Amalekites. Otherwise I will sweep you away with them.
name: Saul

speaker: god
text: I regret that I have made Saul king, for he has turned away from following Me and has not carried out My instructions.
name: The LORD

speaker: unnamed-informant
text: Saul has gone to Carmel, and behold, he has set up a monument for himself and has turned and gone down to Gilgal.
name: An informant

speaker: saul
text: May the LORD bless you. I have carried out the LORD’s instructions.
name: Saul

speaker: samuel
text: Then what is this bleating of sheep and lowing of cattle that I hear?
name: Samuel

speaker: saul
text: The troops brought them from the Amalekites; they spared the best sheep and cattle to sacrifice to the LORD your God, but the rest we devoted to destruction.
name: Saul

speaker: samuel
text: Stop!
name: Samuel

speaker: samuel
text: Let me tell you what the LORD said to me last night.
name: Samuel

speaker: saul
text: Tell me,
name: Saul

speaker: samuel
text: Although you were once small in your own eyes, have you not become the head of the tribes of Israel? The LORD anointed you king over Israel
name: Samuel

speaker: samuel
text: and sent you on a mission, saying, ‘Go and devote to destruction the sinful Amalekites. Fight against them until you have wiped them out.’
name: Samuel

speaker: samuel
text: So why did you not obey the LORD? Why did you rush upon the plunder and do evil in the sight of the LORD?
name: Samuel

speaker: saul
text: But I did obey the LORD,
name: Saul

speaker: saul
text: I went on the mission that the LORD gave me. I brought back Agag king of Amalek and devoted the Amalekites to destruction.
name: Saul

speaker: saul
text: The troops took sheep and cattle from the plunder, the best of the things devoted to destruction, in order to sacrifice them to the LORD your God at Gilgal.
name: Saul

speaker: samuel
text: Does the LORD delight in burnt offerings and sacrifices as much as in obedience to His voice? Behold, obedience is better than sacrifice, and attentiveness is better than the fat of rams.
name: Samuel

speaker: samuel
text: For rebellion is like the sin of divination, and arrogance is like the wickedness of idolatry. Because you have rejected the word of the LORD, He has rejected you as king.
name: Samuel

speaker: saul
text: I have sinned; I have transgressed the LORD’s commandment and your instructions, because I feared the people and obeyed their voice.
name: Saul

speaker: saul
text: Now therefore, please forgive my sin and return with me so I can worship the LORD.
name: Saul

speaker: samuel
text: I will not return with you,
name: Samuel

speaker: samuel
text: For you have rejected the word of the LORD, and He has rejected you as king over Israel.
name: Samuel

speaker: samuel
text: The LORD has torn the kingdom of Israel from you today and has given it to your neighbor who is better than you.
name: Samuel

speaker: samuel
text: Moreover, the Glory of Israel does not lie or change His mind, for He is not a man, that He should change His mind.
name: Samuel

speaker: saul
text: I have sinned,
name: Saul

speaker: saul
text: Please honor me now before the elders of my people and before Israel. Come back with me, so that I may worship the LORD your God.
name: Saul

speaker: samuel
text: Bring me Agag king of the Amalekites.
name: Samuel

speaker: agag
text: Surely the bitterness of death is past.
name: Agag

speaker: samuel
text: As your sword has made women childless, so your mother will be childless among women.
name: Samuel

speaker: god
text: How long are you going to mourn for Saul, since I have rejected him as king over Israel? Fill your horn with oil and go. I am sending you to Jesse of Bethlehem, for I have selected from his sons a king for Myself.
name: The LORD

speaker: samuel
text: How can I go?
name: Samuel

speaker: samuel
text: Saul will hear of it and kill me!
name: Samuel

speaker: god
text: Take a heifer with you and say, ‘I have come to sacrifice to the LORD.’
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Then invite Jesse to the sacrifice, and I will show you what you are to do. You are to anoint for Me the one I indicate.
name: The LORD

speaker: elders-of-bethlehem
text: Do you come in peace?
name: The elders of Bethlehem

speaker: samuel
text: In peace,
name: Samuel

speaker: samuel
text: I have come to sacrifice to the LORD. Consecrate yourselves and come with me to the sacrifice.
name: Samuel

speaker: samuel
text: Surely here before the LORD is His anointed.
name: Samuel

speaker: god
text: Do not consider his appearance or height, for I have rejected him; the LORD does not see as man does. For man sees the outward appearance, but the LORD sees the heart.
name: The LORD

speaker: samuel
text: The LORD has not chosen this one either.
name: Samuel

speaker: samuel
text: The LORD has not chosen this one either.
name: Samuel

speaker: samuel
text: The LORD has not chosen any of these.
name: Samuel

speaker: samuel
text: Are these all the sons you have?
name: Samuel

speaker: jesse
text: There is still the youngest,
name: Jesse

speaker: jesse
text: but he is tending the sheep.
name: Jesse

speaker: samuel
text: Send for him,
name: Samuel

speaker: samuel
text: For we will not sit down to eat until he arrives.
name: Samuel

speaker: god
text: Rise and anoint him, for he is the one.
name: The LORD

speaker: saul-servants
text: Surely a spirit of distress from God is tormenting you.
name: Saul's servants

speaker: saul-servants
text: Let our lord command your servants here to seek out someone who can skillfully play the harp. Whenever the spirit of distress from God is upon you, he is to play it, and you will be well.
name: Saul's servants

speaker: saul
text: Find me someone who plays well, and bring him to me.
name: Saul

speaker: saul-servants
text: I have seen a son of Jesse of Bethlehem who knows how to play the harp. He is a mighty man of valor, a warrior, eloquent and handsome, and the LORD is with him.
name: Saul's servants

speaker: saul
text: Send me your son David, who is with the sheep.
name: Saul

speaker: saul
text: Let David remain in my service, for I am pleased with him.
name: Saul

speaker: goliath
text: Why do you come out and array yourselves for battle? Am I not a Philistine, and are you not servants of Saul? Choose one of your men and have him come down against me.
name: Goliath

speaker: goliath
text: If he is able to fight me and kill me, then we will be your servants. But if I prevail against him and kill him, then you shall be our servants and labor for us.
name: Goliath

speaker: goliath
text: I defy the ranks of Israel this day! Give me a man to fight!
name: Goliath

speaker: jesse
text: Take this ephah of roasted grain and these ten loaves of bread for your brothers and hurry to their camp.
name: Jesse

speaker: jesse
text: Take also these ten portions of cheese to the commander of their unit. Check on the welfare of your brothers and bring back an assurance from them.
name: Jesse

speaker: jesse
text: They are with Saul and all the men of Israel in the Valley of Elah, fighting against the Philistines.
name: Jesse

speaker: israelites
text: Do you see this man who keeps coming out to defy Israel? To the man who kills him the king will give great riches. And he will give him his daughter in marriage and exempt his father’s house from taxation in Israel.
name: The Israelites

speaker: david
text: What will be done for the man who kills this Philistine and removes this disgrace from Israel? Just who is this uncircumcised Philistine, that he should defy the armies of the living God?
name: David

speaker: israelites
text: That is what will be done for the man who kills him.
name: The Israelites

speaker: eliab
text: Why have you come down here?
name: Eliab

speaker: eliab
text: And with whom did you leave those few sheep in the wilderness? I know your pride and wickedness of heart—you have come down to see the battle!
name: Eliab

speaker: david
text: What have I done now?
name: David

speaker: david
text: Was it not just a question?
name: David

speaker: david
text: Let no man’s heart fail on account of this Philistine. Your servant will go and fight him!
name: David

speaker: saul
text: You cannot go out against this Philistine to fight him. You are just a boy, and he has been a warrior from his youth.
name: Saul

speaker: david
text: Your servant has been tending his father’s sheep, and whenever a lion or a bear came and carried off a lamb from the flock,
name: David

speaker: david
text: I went after it, struck it down, and delivered the lamb from its mouth. If it reared up against me, I would grab it by its fur, strike it down, and kill it.
name: David

speaker: david
text: Your servant has killed lions and bears; this uncircumcised Philistine will be like one of them, for he has defied the armies of the living God.
name: David

speaker: david
text: The LORD, who delivered me from the claws of the lion and the bear, will deliver me from the hand of this Philistine.
name: David

speaker: saul
text: Go,
name: Saul

speaker: saul
text: and may the LORD be with you.
name: Saul

speaker: david
text: I cannot walk in these,
name: David

speaker: david
text: I am not accustomed to them.
name: David

speaker: goliath
text: Am I a dog,
name: Goliath

speaker: goliath
text: that you come at me with sticks?
name: Goliath

speaker: goliath
text: Come here,
name: Goliath

speaker: goliath
text: and I will give your flesh to the birds of the air and the beasts of the field!
name: Goliath

speaker: david
text: You come against me with sword and spear and javelin, but I come against you in the name of the LORD of Hosts, the God of the armies of Israel, whom you have defied.
name: David

speaker: david
text: This day the LORD will deliver you into my hand. This day I will strike you down, cut off your head, and give the carcasses of the Philistines to the birds of the air and the creatures of the earth. Then the whole world will know that there is a God in Israel.
name: David

speaker: david
text: And all those assembled here will know that it is not by sword or spear that the LORD saves; for the battle is the LORD’s, and He will give all of you into our hands.
name: David

speaker: saul
text: Abner, whose son is this young man?
name: Saul

speaker: abner
text: As surely as you live, O king,
name: Abner

speaker: abner
text: I do not know.
name: Abner

speaker: saul
text: Find out whose son this young man is!
name: Saul

speaker: saul
text: Whose son are you, young man?
name: Saul

speaker: david
text: I am the son of your servant Jesse of Bethlehem,
name: David

speaker: israelite-women
text: Saul has slain his thousands, and David his tens of thousands.
name: The women of Israel

speaker: saul
text: They have ascribed tens of thousands to David,
name: Saul

speaker: saul
text: but only thousands to me. What more can he have but the kingdom?
name: Saul

speaker: saul
text: I will pin David to the wall.
name: Saul

speaker: saul
text: Here is my older daughter Merab. I will give her to you in marriage. Only be valiant for me and fight the LORD’s battles.
name: Saul

speaker: saul
text: I need not raise my hand against him; let the hand of the Philistines be against him.
name: Saul

speaker: david
text: Who am I, and what is my family or my father’s clan in Israel, that I should become the son-in-law of the king?
name: David

speaker: saul
text: I will give her to David,
name: Saul

speaker: saul
text: so that she may be a snare to him, and the hand of the Philistines may be against him.
name: Saul

speaker: saul
text: For a second time now you can be my son-in-law.
name: Saul

speaker: saul
text: Speak to David privately and tell him, ‘Behold, the king is pleased with you, and all his servants love you. Now therefore, become his son-in-law.’
name: Saul

speaker: david
text: Does it seem trivial in your sight to be the son-in-law of the king? I am a poor man and lightly esteemed.
name: David

speaker: saul
text: Say to David, ‘The king desires no other dowry but a hundred Philistine foreskins as revenge on his enemies.’
name: Saul

speaker: jonathan
text: My father Saul intends to kill you. Be on your guard in the morning; find a secret place and hide there.
name: Jonathan

speaker: jonathan
text: I will go out and stand beside my father in the field where you are, so I can ask about you. And if I find out anything, I will tell you.
name: Jonathan

speaker: jonathan
text: The king should not sin against his servant David; he has not sinned against you. In fact, his actions have been highly beneficial to you.
name: Jonathan

speaker: jonathan
text: He took his life in his hands when he struck down the Philistine, and the LORD worked a great salvation for all Israel. You saw it and rejoiced, so why would you sin against innocent blood by killing David for no reason?
name: Jonathan

speaker: saul
text: As surely as the LORD lives, David will not be put to death.
name: Saul

speaker: michal
text: If you do not run for your life tonight, tomorrow you will be dead!
name: Michal

speaker: michal
text: He is ill.
name: Michal

speaker: saul
text: Bring him up to me in his bed so I can kill him.
name: Saul

speaker: saul
text: Why did you deceive me like this? You sent my enemy away and he has escaped!
name: Saul

speaker: michal
text: He said to me, ‘Help me get away, or I will kill you!’
name: Michal

speaker: saul
text: Where are Samuel and David?
name: Saul

speaker: unnamed-informant
text: At Naioth in Ramah,
name: An informant

speaker: david
text: What have I done? What is my iniquity? How have I sinned against your father, that he wants to take my life?
name: David

speaker: jonathan
text: Far from it!
name: Jonathan

speaker: jonathan
text: You will not die. Indeed, my father does nothing, great or small, without telling me. So why would he hide this matter from me? This cannot be true!
name: Jonathan

speaker: david
text: Your father knows very well that I have found favor in your eyes, and he has said, ‘Jonathan must not know of this, or he will be grieved.’ As surely as the LORD lives and as you yourself live, there is but a step between me and death.
name: David

speaker: jonathan
text: Whatever you desire, I will do for you.
name: Jonathan

speaker: david
text: Look, tomorrow is the New Moon, and I am supposed to dine with the king. Instead, let me go and hide in the field until the third evening from now.
name: David

speaker: david
text: If your father misses me at all, tell him, ‘David urgently requested my permission to hurry to Bethlehem, his hometown, because there is an annual sacrifice for his whole clan.’
name: David

speaker: david
text: If he says, ‘Good,’ then your servant is safe, but if he is enraged, you will know he has evil intentions.
name: David

speaker: david
text: Therefore deal faithfully with your servant, for you have brought me into a covenant with you before the LORD. If there is iniquity in me, then kill me yourself; why should you bring me to your father?
name: David

speaker: jonathan
text: Never!
name: Jonathan

speaker: jonathan
text: If I ever found out that my father had evil intentions against you, would I not tell you?
name: Jonathan

speaker: david
text: Who will tell me if your father answers you harshly?
name: David

speaker: jonathan
text: Come,
name: Jonathan

speaker: jonathan
text: let us go out to the field.
name: Jonathan

speaker: jonathan
text: By the LORD, the God of Israel, I will sound out my father by this time tomorrow or the next day. If he is favorable toward you, will I not send for you and tell you?
name: Jonathan

speaker: jonathan
text: But if my father intends to bring evil on you, then may the LORD punish me, and ever so severely, if I do not tell you and send you on your way in safety. May the LORD be with you, just as He has been with my father.
name: Jonathan

speaker: jonathan
text: And as long as I live, treat me with the LORD’s loving devotion, that I may not die,
name: Jonathan

speaker: jonathan
text: and do not ever cut off your loving devotion from my household—not even when the LORD cuts off every one of David’s enemies from the face of the earth.
name: Jonathan

speaker: jonathan
text: May the LORD hold David’s enemies accountable.
name: Jonathan

speaker: jonathan
text: Tomorrow is the New Moon, and you will be missed if your seat is empty.
name: Jonathan

speaker: jonathan
text: When you have stayed three days, hurry down to the place you hid on the day this trouble began, and remain beside the stone Ezel.
name: Jonathan

speaker: jonathan
text: I will shoot three arrows to the side of it, as if I were aiming at a target.
name: Jonathan

speaker: jonathan
text: Then I will send a boy and say, ‘Go, find the arrows!’ Now, if I expressly say to him, ‘Look, the arrows are on this side of you; bring them,’ then come, because as surely as the LORD lives, it is safe for you and there is no danger.
name: Jonathan

speaker: jonathan
text: But if I say to the young man, ‘Look, the arrows are beyond you,’ then you must go, for the LORD has sent you away.
name: Jonathan

speaker: jonathan
text: And as for the matter you and I have discussed, the LORD is a witness between you and me forever.
name: Jonathan

speaker: saul
text: Something has happened to David to make him ceremonially unclean—surely he is unclean.
name: Saul

speaker: saul
text: Why hasn’t the son of Jesse come to the meal either yesterday or today?
name: Saul

speaker: jonathan
text: David urgently requested my permission to go to Bethlehem,
name: Jonathan

speaker: jonathan
text: saying, ‘Please let me go, because our clan is holding a sacrifice in the city, and my brother has told me to be there. So now, if I have found favor in your eyes, please let me go and see my brothers.’ That is why he did not come to the king’s table.
name: Jonathan

speaker: saul
text: You son of a perverse and rebellious woman! Do I not know that you have chosen the son of Jesse to your own shame and to the disgrace of the mother who bore you?
name: Saul

speaker: saul
text: For as long as the son of Jesse lives on this earth, neither you nor your kingship shall be established. Now send for him and bring him to me, for he must surely die!
name: Saul

speaker: jonathan
text: Why must he be put to death?
name: Jonathan

speaker: jonathan
text: What has he done?
name: Jonathan

speaker: jonathan
text: Run and find the arrows I shoot.
name: Jonathan

speaker: jonathan
text: Isn’t the arrow beyond you?
name: Jonathan

speaker: jonathan
text: Hurry! Make haste! Do not delay!
name: Jonathan

speaker: jonathan
text: Go, take it back to the city.
name: Jonathan

speaker: jonathan
text: Go in peace, for the two of us have sworn in the name of the LORD, saying, ‘May the LORD be a witness between you and me, and between your descendants and mine forever.’
name: Jonathan

speaker: ahimelech
text: Why are you alone? Why is no one with you?
name: Ahimelech the priest

speaker: david
text: The king has given me a mission,
name: David

speaker: david
text: He told me no one is to know about the mission or charge. And I have directed my young men to meet me at a certain place.
name: David

speaker: david
text: Now then, what do you have on hand? Give me five loaves of bread, or whatever can be found.
name: David

speaker: ahimelech
text: There is no common bread on hand,
name: Ahimelech the priest

speaker: ahimelech
text: but there is some consecrated bread—provided that the young men have kept themselves from women.
name: Ahimelech the priest

speaker: david
text: Women have indeed been kept from us, as is usual when I set out. And the equipment of the young men is holy, as it is even on common missions, and all the more at this time.
name: David

speaker: david
text: Is there not a spear or sword on hand here? For I have brought neither my sword nor my weapons with me, because the king’s business was urgent.
name: David

speaker: ahimelech
text: The sword of Goliath the Philistine, whom you killed in the Valley of Elah, is here; it is wrapped in a cloth behind the ephod. If you want, you may take it. For there is no other but this one.
name: Ahimelech the priest

speaker: david
text: There is none like it; give it to me.
name: David

speaker: achish-servants
text: Is this not David, the king of the land? Did they not sing about him in their dances, saying: ‘Saul has slain his thousands, and David his tens of thousands’?
name: The servants of Achish

speaker: achish
text: Look, you can see that the man is insane! Why have you brought him to me?
name: Achish

speaker: achish
text: Am I in need of madmen, that you have brought this man to rave in my presence? Must this man come into my house?
name: Achish

speaker: david
text: Please let my father and mother stay with you until I learn what God will do for me.
name: David

speaker: gad
text: Do not stay in the stronghold. Depart and go into the land of Judah.
name: Gad the prophet

speaker: saul
text: Listen, men of Benjamin! Is the son of Jesse giving all of you fields and vineyards and making you commanders of thousands or hundreds?
name: Saul

speaker: saul
text: Is that why all of you have conspired against me? Not one of you told me that my own son had made a covenant with the son of Jesse. Not one of you has shown concern for me or revealed to me that my son has stirred up my own servant to lie in wait against me, as is the case today.
name: Saul

speaker: doeg
text: I saw the son of Jesse come to Ahimelech son of Ahitub at Nob.
name: Doeg the Edomite

speaker: doeg
text: Ahimelech inquired of the LORD for him and gave him provisions. He also gave him the sword of Goliath the Philistine.
name: Doeg the Edomite

speaker: saul
text: Listen now, son of Ahitub,
name: Saul

speaker: ahimelech
text: Here I am, my lord,
name: Ahimelech the priest

speaker: saul
text: Why have you and the son of Jesse conspired against me? You gave him bread and a sword and inquired of God for him so that he could rise up against me to lie in wait, as he is doing today.
name: Saul

speaker: ahimelech
text: Who among all your servants is as faithful as David, the king’s son-in-law, the captain of your bodyguard who is honored in your house?
name: Ahimelech the priest

speaker: ahimelech
text: Was that day the first time I inquired of God for him? Far be it from me! Let not the king accuse your servant or any of my father’s household, for your servant knew nothing of this whole affair—not in part or in whole.
name: Ahimelech the priest

speaker: saul
text: You will surely die, Ahimelech, you and all your father’s house!
name: Saul

speaker: saul
text: Turn and kill the priests of the LORD, because they too sided with David. For they knew he was fleeing, but they did not tell me.
name: Saul

speaker: saul
text: You turn and strike down the priests!
name: Saul

speaker: david
text: I knew that Doeg the Edomite was there that day, and that he was sure to tell Saul. I myself am responsible for the lives of everyone in your father’s house.
name: David

speaker: david
text: Stay with me; do not be afraid, for he who seeks your life is seeking mine as well. You will be safe with me.
name: David

speaker: unnamed-informant
text: Look, the Philistines are fighting against Keilah and looting the threshing floors.
name: An informant

speaker: david
text: Should I go and attack these Philistines?
name: David

speaker: god
text: Go and attack the Philistines and save Keilah.
name: The LORD

speaker: david-men
text: Look, we are afraid here in Judah; how much more if we go to Keilah against the armies of the Philistines?
name: David's men

speaker: god
text: Go at once to Keilah, for I will deliver the Philistines into your hand.
name: The LORD

speaker: saul
text: God has delivered him into my hand, for he has trapped himself by entering a town with gates and bars.
name: Saul

speaker: david
text: Bring the ephod.
name: David

speaker: david
text: O LORD, God of Israel, Your servant has heard that Saul intends to come to Keilah and destroy the city on my account.
name: David

speaker: david
text: Will the citizens of Keilah surrender me into his hand? Will Saul come down, as Your servant has heard? O LORD, God of Israel, please tell Your servant.
name: David

speaker: god
text: He will,
name: The LORD

speaker: david
text: Will the citizens of Keilah surrender me and my men into the hand of Saul?
name: David

speaker: god
text: They will,
name: The LORD

speaker: jonathan
text: Do not be afraid, for my father Saul will never lay a hand on you. And you will be king over Israel, and I will be your second-in-command. Even my father Saul knows this is true.
name: Jonathan

speaker: ziphites
text: Is not David hiding among us in the strongholds at Horesh, on the hill of Hachilah south of Jeshimon?
name: The Ziphites

speaker: ziphites
text: Now, O king, come down whenever your soul desires, and we will be responsible for delivering him into your hand.
name: The Ziphites

speaker: saul
text: May you be blessed by the LORD,
name: Saul

speaker: saul
text: for you have had compassion on me.
name: Saul

speaker: saul
text: Please go and prepare further. Investigate and watch carefully where he goes and who has seen him there, for I am told that he is extremely cunning.
name: Saul

speaker: saul
text: Observe and find out all the places where he hides. Then come back to me with certainty, and I will go with you. If he is in the land, I will search him out among all the clans of Judah.
name: Saul

speaker: messenger
text: Come quickly, for the Philistines have raided the land!
name: A messenger

speaker: unnamed-informant
text: David is in the wilderness of En-gedi.
name: An informant

speaker: david-men
text: This is the day about which the LORD said to you, ‘Behold, I will deliver your enemy into your hand, that you may do with him as you wish.’
name: David's men

speaker: david
text: The LORD forbid that I should do such a thing to my master, the LORD’s anointed. May I never lift my hand against him, since he is the LORD’s anointed.
name: David

speaker: david
text: My lord the king!
name: David

speaker: david
text: Why do you listen to the words of men who say, ‘Look, David intends to harm you’?
name: David

speaker: david
text: Behold, this day you have seen with your own eyes that the LORD delivered you into my hand in the cave. I was told to kill you, but I spared you and said, ‘I will not lift my hand against my lord, since he is the LORD’s anointed.’
name: David

speaker: david
text: See, my father, look at the corner of your robe in my hand. For I cut it off, but I did not kill you. See and know that there is no evil or rebellion in my hands. I have not sinned against you, even though you are hunting me down to take my life.
name: David

speaker: david
text: May the LORD judge between you and me, and may the LORD take vengeance on you, but my hand will never be against you.
name: David

speaker: david
text: As the old proverb says, ‘Wickedness proceeds from the wicked.’ But my hand will never be against you.
name: David

speaker: david
text: Against whom has the king of Israel come out? Whom are you pursuing? A dead dog? A flea?
name: David

speaker: david
text: May the LORD be our judge and decide between you and me. May He take notice and plead my case and deliver me from your hand.
name: David

speaker: saul
text: Is that your voice, David my son?
name: Saul

speaker: saul
text: You are more righteous than I, for you have rewarded me with good, though I have rewarded you with evil.
name: Saul

speaker: saul
text: And you have shown this day how well you have dealt with me; for when the LORD delivered me into your hand, you did not kill me.
name: Saul

speaker: saul
text: When a man finds his enemy, does he let him go away unharmed? May the LORD reward you with good for what you have done for me this day.
name: Saul

speaker: saul
text: Now I know for sure that you will be king, and that the kingdom of Israel will be established in your hands.
name: Saul

speaker: saul
text: So now, swear to me by the LORD that you will not cut off my descendants or wipe out my name from my father’s house.
name: Saul

speaker: david
text: Go up to Nabal at Carmel. Greet him in my name
name: David

speaker: david
text: and say to him, ‘Long life to you, and peace to you and your house and to all that belongs to you.
name: David

speaker: david
text: Now I hear that it is time for shearing. When your shepherds were with us, we did not harass them, and nothing of theirs was missing the whole time they were in Carmel.
name: David

speaker: david
text: Ask your young men, and they will tell you. So let my young men find favor with you, for we have come on the day of a feast. Please give whatever you can afford to your servants and to your son David.’
name: David

speaker: nabal
text: Who is David? Who is this son of Jesse? Many servants these days are breaking away from their masters.
name: Nabal

speaker: nabal
text: Why should I take my bread and water and the meat I have slaughtered for my shearers, and give them to these men whose origin I do not know?
name: Nabal

speaker: david
text: Strap on your swords!
name: David

speaker: nabal-servant
text: Look, David sent messengers from the wilderness to greet our master, but he scolded them.
name: Nabal's servant

speaker: nabal-servant
text: Yet these men were very good to us. When we were in the field, we were not harassed, and nothing of ours went missing the whole time we lived among them.
name: Nabal's servant

speaker: nabal-servant
text: They were a wall around us, both day and night, the whole time we were herding our sheep near them.
name: Nabal's servant

speaker: nabal-servant
text: Now consider carefully what you must do, because disaster looms over our master and all his household. For he is such a scoundrel that nobody can speak to him!
name: Nabal's servant

speaker: abigail
text: Go ahead of me. I will be right behind you.
name: Abigail

speaker: david
text: In vain I have protected all that belonged to this man in the wilderness. Nothing that belongs to him has gone missing, yet he has paid me back evil for good.
name: David

speaker: david
text: May God punish David, and ever so severely, if I let one of Nabal’s men survive until morning.
name: David

speaker: abigail
text: My lord, may the blame be on me alone, but please let your servant speak to you; hear the words of your servant.
name: Abigail

speaker: abigail
text: My lord should pay no attention to this scoundrel Nabal, for he lives up to his name: His name means Fool, and folly accompanies him. I, your servant, did not see my lord’s young men whom you sent.
name: Abigail

speaker: abigail
text: Now, my lord, as surely as the LORD lives and you yourself live, the LORD has held you back from coming to bloodshed and avenging yourself with your own hand. May your enemies and those who seek harm for my lord be like Nabal.
name: Abigail

speaker: abigail
text: Now let this gift your servant has brought to my lord be given to the young men who follow you.
name: Abigail

speaker: abigail
text: Please forgive your servant’s offense, for the LORD will surely make a lasting dynasty for my lord, because he fights the LORD’s battles. May no evil be found in you as long as you live.
name: Abigail

speaker: abigail
text: And should someone pursue you and seek your life, then the life of my lord will be bound securely by the LORD your God in the bundle of the living. But He shall fling away the lives of your enemies like stones from a sling.
name: Abigail

speaker: abigail
text: When the LORD has done for my lord all the good He promised, and when He has appointed you ruler over Israel,
name: Abigail

speaker: abigail
text: then my lord will have no remorse or guilt of conscience over needless bloodshed and revenge. And when the LORD has dealt well with my lord, may you remember your maidservant.
name: Abigail

speaker: david
text: Blessed be the LORD, the God of Israel, who sent you to meet me this day!
name: David

speaker: david
text: Blessed is your discernment, and blessed are you, because today you kept me from bloodshed and from avenging myself by my own hand.
name: David

speaker: david
text: Otherwise, as surely as the LORD, the God of Israel, lives, who has restrained me from harming you, if you had not come quickly to meet me, then surely no male belonging to Nabal would have been left alive by morning light.
name: David

speaker: david
text: Go home in peace. See, I have heeded your voice and granted your request.
name: David

speaker: david
text: Blessed be the LORD, who has upheld my cause against the reproach of Nabal and has restrained His servant from evil. For the LORD has brought the wickedness of Nabal down upon his own head.
name: David

speaker: david-servants
text: David has sent us to take you as his wife.
name: David's servants

speaker: abigail
text: Here is your maidservant, ready to serve and to wash the feet of my lord’s servants.
name: Abigail

speaker: ziphites
text: Is not David hiding on the hill of Hachilah, opposite Jeshimon?
name: The Ziphites

speaker: david
text: Who will go down with me to Saul in the camp?
name: David

speaker: abishai
text: I will go with you,
name: Abishai

speaker: abishai
text: Today God has delivered your enemy into your hand. Now, therefore, please let me thrust the spear through him into the ground with one stroke. I will not need to strike him twice!
name: Abishai

speaker: david
text: Do not destroy him, for who can lift a hand against the LORD’s anointed and be guiltless?
name: David

speaker: david
text: As surely as the LORD lives, the LORD Himself will strike him down; either his day will come and he will die, or he will go into battle and perish.
name: David

speaker: david
text: But the LORD forbid that I should stretch out my hand against the LORD’s anointed. Instead, take the spear and water jug by his head, and let us go.
name: David

speaker: david
text: Will you not answer me, Abner?
name: David

speaker: abner
text: Who calls to the king?
name: Abner

speaker: david
text: You are a man, aren’t you? And who in Israel is your equal? Why then did you not protect your lord the king when one of the people came to destroy him?
name: David

speaker: david
text: This thing you have done is not good. As surely as the LORD lives, all of you deserve to die, since you did not protect your lord, the LORD’s anointed. Now look around. Where are the king’s spear and water jug that were by his head?
name: David

speaker: saul
text: Is that your voice, David my son?
name: Saul

speaker: david
text: It is my voice, my lord and king,
name: David

speaker: david
text: Why is my lord pursuing his servant? What have I done? What evil is in my hand?
name: David

speaker: david
text: Now please, may my lord the king hear the words of his servant: If the LORD has stirred you up against me, then may He accept an offering. But if men have done it, may they be cursed in the presence of the LORD! For today they have driven me away from sharing in the inheritance of the LORD, saying, ‘Go, serve other gods.’
name: David

speaker: david
text: So do not let my blood fall to the ground far from the presence of the LORD. For the king of Israel has come out to look for a flea, like one who hunts a partridge in the mountains.
name: David

speaker: saul
text: I have sinned. Come back, David my son. I will never harm you again, because today you considered my life precious. I have played the fool and have committed a grave error!
name: Saul

speaker: david
text: Here is the king’s spear,
name: David

speaker: david
text: Let one of the young men come over and get it.
name: David

speaker: david
text: May the LORD repay every man for his righteousness and faithfulness. For the LORD delivered you into my hand today, but I would not stretch out my hand against the LORD’s anointed.
name: David

speaker: david
text: As surely as I valued your life today, so may the LORD value my life and rescue me from all trouble.
name: David

speaker: saul
text: May you be blessed, David my son. You will accomplish great things and will surely prevail.
name: Saul

speaker: david
text: One of these days now I will be swept away by the hand of Saul. There is nothing better for me than to escape to the land of the Philistines. Then Saul will stop searching for me all over Israel, and I will slip out of his hand.
name: David

speaker: david
text: If I have found favor in your eyes, let me be assigned a place in one of the outlying towns, so I can live there. For why should your servant live in the royal city with you?
name: David

speaker: achish
text: What have you raided today?
name: Achish

speaker: david
text: The Negev of Judah,
name: David

speaker: david
text: The Negev of Jerahmeel,
name: David

speaker: david
text: The Negev of the Kenites.
name: David

speaker: david
text: Otherwise they will report us, saying, ‘This is what David did.’
name: David

speaker: achish
text: Since he has made himself an utter stench to his people Israel, he will be my servant forever.
name: Achish

speaker: achish
text: You must understand that you and your men are to go out to battle with me.
name: Achish

speaker: david
text: Then you will come to know what your servant can do.
name: David

speaker: achish
text: Very well,
name: Achish

speaker: achish
text: I will make you my bodyguard for life.
name: Achish

speaker: saul
text: Find me a woman who is a medium, so I can go and consult her.
name: Saul

speaker: saul-servants
text: There is a medium at Endor,
name: Saul's servants

speaker: saul
text: Consult a spirit for me. Bring up for me the one I name.
name: Saul

speaker: medium
text: Surely you know what Saul has done, how he has killed the mediums and spiritists in the land. Why have you set a trap to get me killed?
name: The medium of Endor

speaker: saul
text: As surely as the LORD lives, no punishment shall come upon you for this.
name: Saul

speaker: medium
text: Whom shall I bring up for you?
name: The medium of Endor

speaker: saul
text: Bring up Samuel,
name: Saul

speaker: medium
text: Why have you deceived me? You are Saul!
name: The medium of Endor

speaker: saul
text: Do not be afraid,
name: Saul

speaker: saul
text: What do you see?
name: Saul

speaker: medium
text: I see a god coming up out of the earth,
name: The medium of Endor

speaker: saul
text: What does he look like?
name: Saul

speaker: medium
text: An old man is coming up,
name: The medium of Endor

speaker: medium
text: And he is wearing a robe.
name: The medium of Endor

speaker: samuel
text: Why have you disturbed me by bringing me up?
name: Samuel

speaker: saul
text: I am deeply distressed,
name: Saul

speaker: saul
text: The Philistines are fighting against me, and God has turned away from me. He no longer answers me, either by prophets or by dreams. So I have called on you to tell me what to do.
name: Saul

speaker: samuel
text: Why do you consult me,
name: Samuel

speaker: samuel
text: since the LORD has turned away from you and become your enemy?
name: Samuel

speaker: samuel
text: He has done exactly what He spoke through me: The LORD has torn the kingship out of your hand and given it to your neighbor David.
name: Samuel

speaker: samuel
text: Because you did not obey the LORD or carry out His burning anger against Amalek, the LORD has done this to you today.
name: Samuel

speaker: samuel
text: Moreover, the LORD will deliver Israel with you into the hand of the Philistines, and tomorrow you and your sons will be with me. And the LORD will deliver the army of Israel into the hand of the Philistines.
name: Samuel

speaker: medium
text: Look, your maidservant has obeyed your voice. I took my life in my hands and did as you told me.
name: The medium of Endor

speaker: medium
text: Now please listen to your servant and let me set a morsel of bread before you so you may eat and have the strength to go on your way.
name: The medium of Endor

speaker: saul
text: I will not eat.
name: Saul

speaker: philistine-commanders
text: What about these Hebrews?
name: The Philistine commanders

speaker: achish
text: Is this not David, the servant of King Saul of Israel? He has been with me all these days, even years, and from the day he defected until today I have found no fault in him.
name: Achish

speaker: philistine-commanders
text: Send that man back and let him return to the place you assigned him. He must not go down with us into battle only to become our adversary during the war. What better way for him to regain the favor of his master than with the heads of our men?
name: The Philistine commanders

speaker: philistine-commanders
text: Is this not the David about whom they sing in their dances: ‘Saul has slain his thousands, and David his tens of thousands’?
name: The Philistine commanders

speaker: achish
text: As surely as the LORD lives, you have been upright in my sight, and it seems right that you should march in and out with me in the army, because I have found no fault in you from the day you came to me until this day. But you have no favor in the sight of the leaders.
name: Achish

speaker: achish
text: Therefore turn back now and go in peace, so that you will not do anything to displease the leaders of the Philistines.
name: Achish

speaker: david
text: But what have I done?
name: David

speaker: david
text: What have you found against your servant, from the day I came to you until today, to keep me from going along to fight against the enemies of my lord the king?
name: David

speaker: achish
text: I know that you are as pleasing in my sight as an angel of God. But the commanders of the Philistines have said, ‘He must not go into battle with us.’
name: Achish

speaker: achish
text: Now then, get up early in the morning, along with your master’s servants who came with you, and go as soon as it is light.
name: Achish

speaker: david
text: Bring me the ephod.
name: David

speaker: david
text: Should I pursue these raiders? Will I overtake them?
name: David

speaker: god
text: Pursue them,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: for you will surely overtake them and rescue the captives.
name: The LORD

speaker: david
text: To whom do you belong, and where are you from?
name: David

speaker: egyptian
text: I am an Egyptian,
name: The Egyptian slave

speaker: egyptian
text: the slave of an Amalekite. My master abandoned me three days ago when I fell ill.
name: The Egyptian slave

speaker: egyptian
text: We raided the Negev of the Cherethites, the territory of Judah, and the Negev of Caleb, and we burned down Ziklag.
name: The Egyptian slave

speaker: david
text: Will you lead me to these raiders?
name: David

speaker: egyptian
text: Swear to me by God that you will not kill me or deliver me into the hand of my master, and I will lead you to them.
name: The Egyptian slave

speaker: david-men
text: This is David’s plunder!
name: David's men

speaker: worthless-men
text: Because they did not go with us, we will not share with them the plunder we recovered, except for each man’s wife and children. They may take them and go.
name: Worthless men

speaker: david
text: My brothers, you must not do this with what the LORD has given us. He has protected us and delivered into our hands the raiders who came against us.
name: David

speaker: david
text: Who will listen to your proposal? The share of the one who went to battle will match the share of the one who stayed with the supplies. They will share alike.
name: David

speaker: david
text: Here is a gift for you from the plunder of the LORD’s enemies.
name: David

speaker: saul
text: Draw your sword and run it through me, or these uncircumcised men will come and run me through and torture me!
name: Saul
